content.contents: what does it mean to go until you are gone? i'll talk more on it some other time, maybe when the album comes out fully. i love this artwork. i think the arrangement is nice, but especially the poignant response of yuki's trauma. sometimes we do want to hear only negativity because there's a kind of comfort in self-abuse. if you can admit that you are always and only a piece of shit you don't really have to hold yourself to any standard. but how many people will you hurt in that act? should you care about them? will you?
